original_target.title: Are all flat SU(2) Chern–Simons values on closed three-manifolds rational?

full_original_statement: Let $`A`$ be a flat connection on the trivial $`SU(2)`$ bundle over a closed oriented three-manifold $`M`$. Is its Chern–Simons invariant $`CS(M,A)`$ always rational (with the usual normalization modulo integers)? Equivalently, can an exact irrational critical value occur?
queries: "SU(2)" "Chern Simons" "irrational" (site:arxiv.org OR site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com)
searched_channels: general web and primary author/publisher routing

sources.scope_comparison: The local target is rationality modulo integers of every exact flat compact SU(2) Chern–Simons critical value on every closed oriented3-manifold. The primary final theorem1.18 gives a numerical approximation with error at most10^-50, followed by an explicit irrationality conjecture1.19. Finite decimal precision cannot establish irrationality. Graph-manifold rationality is a restricted class; complex SL2(C) values do not match the compact SU2 target. Primary indexed theorem text was readable although a later direct open timed out. No later exact counterexample, universal proof or matching complete announcement was located.
